name: Do different types of stucco require different repair methods?

mainEntity.name: Do different types of stucco require different repair methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, different types of stucco, such as traditional three-coat cement stucco versus Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS) or synthetic stucco, often require distinct repair methods and materials. Traditional stucco repairs involve cement-based mixes, while EIFS repairs use specialized synthetic materials and sealants. Understanding the stucco type on your property is crucial for effective and long-lasting repairs, preventing further complications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, traditional cement stucco and synthetic stucco (EIFS) require different repair methods and materials for effective results.
